message.content:
Based on the screenshot, here is a detailed description:

**Screen Type:**
This is **not the home screen**, but rather a **full-screen QR scanner interface** (or "Scan QR Slot" screen). It features a camera overlay designed to capture QR codes.

**Key Visual Elements:**
*   **Scanner Overlay:** The center of the screen has a large dark area with **yellow corner brackets** indicating where to align the QR code. There is also a horizontal yellow scanning line animation in the middle.
*   **Header:** At the top, there is a header with a yellow icon, the title "**Scan QR Slot**", and instructional text in Indonesian: "*Arahkan kamera ke QR permainan yang terpasang di tap slot*" (Point the camera at the game QR code installed on the tap slot). A close (X) button is on the right.
*   **Manual Input Section:** Below the scanner area, there is an input field pre-filled with "mis. A-07" (example A-07) next to a bright yellow "**Scan**" button. Below this is text reading "*atau ketik kode slot*" (or type the slot code).
*   **Session Info ("SESI SAYA"):** This section displays active sessions with green buttons for slots like **A-03** ("Scan untuk keluar") and yellow/outline buttons for **B-05** and **A-09** ("Check-in di sini").
*   **Slot Selection Grid ("PILIH SLOT..."):** A grid of teal-outlined buttons representing available slots (A-01 through B-14).

**Bottom Navigation:**
There is **no traditional bottom navigation bar** (like Home, Profile, or Settings tabs) visible on this specific screen. The content extends all the way to the bottom edge of the display. The only interactive element at the very bottom left appears to be a small floating action button with an "N" or similar icon, but it is not part of a standard navbar.

**Regarding the QR Scan Button:**
The primary action for scanning is the prominent **yellow "Scan" button** located in the middle-lower section of the screen, directly to the right of the text input field. It is not located in a bottom navigation bar.
